name: gate-driver-core-drive
description: End-to-end gate-driver signal chain (design/netlist/gate_driver_core.spice, issue #98): logic-in (IN) -> level_shifter -> output_stage -> 1 nF reference load, driven as one connected chain (not an isolated sub-cell) -- substantiates spec/gate-driver.md Sec.3's block-level drive targets end-to-end, and probes the chain's thick-oxide gate nodes (IN_DRV, x2.n1..x2.n5) against spec Sec.2.3's ceiling under REAL inter-cell drive (issue #100).
analyses: meas tran trise10_90 TRIG v(OUT) VAL=outlo RISE=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outhi RISE=1
meas tran tfall10_90 TRIG v(OUT) VAL=outhi FALL=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outlo FALL=1
meas tran tpdlh TRIG v(IN) VAL=inmid RISE=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outmid RISE=1
meas tran tpdhl TRIG v(IN) VAL=inmid FALL=1 TARG v(OUT) VAL=outmid FALL=1

trise_s.description: spec Sec.3: 10-90% rise into 1nF reference load < 50ns, end-to-end IN->OUT (no stretch target -- spec Sec.3's Rise/fall row is '-' at the 6V stretch corner)

tfall_s.description: spec Sec.3: 10-90% fall into 1nF reference load < 50ns, end-to-end IN->OUT (no stretch target -- spec Sec.3's Rise/fall row is '-' at the 6V stretch corner)

tpdlh_s.description: spec Sec.3: low-to-high propagation delay < 50ns nominal, < 25ns at the 6V vdrv stretch corner, end-to-end IN->OUT

tpdhl_s.description: spec Sec.3: high-to-low propagation delay < 50ns nominal, < 25ns at the 6V vdrv stretch corner, end-to-end IN->OUT

ipeak_source_a.description: spec Sec.3: peak source current into 1nF load >= 0.5A nominal, >= 1A at the 6V vdrv stretch corner

ipeak_sink_a.description: spec Sec.3: peak sink current into 1nF load >= 0.5A nominal, >= 1A at the 6V vdrv stretch corner

vout_max_v.description: sanity: OUT must not exceed the swept drive rail plus headroom (no uncontrolled overshoot source in this chain)

vout_min_v.description: sanity: OUT must not undershoot below GND_DRV -- the same inherited -50mV band as indrv_min_v below

indrv_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: IN_DRV -- the level shifter's drive-rail-referenced output, and the THICK-OXIDE gate of the output stage's first taper inverter (x2.XMP1/x2.XMN1) -- must not exceed the swept rail plus headroom. This node is only observable in the end-to-end chain: sim/output-stage-drive drives it from an ideal source and sim/level-shifter-oxide-safety loads it with a lumped cap, so neither per-cell record measures the real level-shifter-driving-output-stage excursion. The 6.6V bound matches the sibling n1..n5 convention; spec Sec.2.3's 6.0V thick-oxide DC ceiling is evaluated row-by-row in the record narrative, because the harness cannot express a rail-dependent bound (issue #125)

indrv_min_v.description: sanity: IN_DRV must not undershoot GND_DRV. The -50mV band is the tolerance sim/output-stage-drive/testbench/tb.json already established for this class of node -- NOT a spec value -- carried over unchanged rather than retuned to whatever this end-to-end chain happens to produce (CLAUDE.md: agents do not relax a bound to make results pass). See the record narrative for the coupling-undershoot rows that miss it

n1_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: output-stage taper node n1 (x2.n1, gate of MP2/MN2) under REAL level-shifter drive rather than sim/output-stage-drive's ideal 1ns input edge

n1_min_v.description: sanity: taper node n1 must not undershoot GND_DRV -- same inherited -50mV band as indrv_min_v, carried over unchanged

n2_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: output-stage taper node n2 under real level-shifter drive

n2_min_v.description: sanity: taper node n2 must not undershoot GND_DRV -- same inherited -50mV band as indrv_min_v, carried over unchanged

n3_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: output-stage taper node n3 under real level-shifter drive

n3_min_v.description: sanity: taper node n3 must not undershoot GND_DRV -- same inherited -50mV band as indrv_min_v, carried over unchanged

n4_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: output-stage taper node n4 under real level-shifter drive

n4_min_v.description: sanity: taper node n4 must not undershoot GND_DRV -- same inherited -50mV band as indrv_min_v, carried over unchanged

n5_max_v.description: spec Sec.2.3 gate-ceiling evidence: output-stage taper node n5 (gate of the final push-pull MP6/MN6) under real level-shifter drive

n5_min_v.description: sanity: taper node n5 must not undershoot GND_DRV -- same inherited -50mV band as indrv_min_v, carried over unchanged
